claims.assertion: The article describes Naki bide’taa’ii as untamable sixth-density equines with two close forehead horns that can move between densities.
claims.speaker: Article text (credited to Anéeka and Yazhi; paragraph-level attribution unspecified)

claims.assertion: Yazhi says imagined unicorns exist in higher densities as ideas or conscious beings that may choose this form to communicate downward.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: She says higher-density beings may project forms downward by intention, with manifestation becoming faster as density rises.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Anéeka reports no records of winged horses; she describes tiny white semi-equine creatures on Cyndriel and Aldebaran as seahorse-like, not quadrupeds.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
